text.description_html:
Mechanical Keyless Narrow Stile Lever Lock, Lockey 2985

The Lockey Mechanical Keypad Lever Lock retrofits Adams Rite style storefront lock systems and includes levers on interior and exterior. It is ideal for aluminum storefront doors and gates and is available in 9 finishes. Easy to install, program and maintain.

Features of the Lockey 2985 Keyless Lever Lock

  • Mechanical keyless narrow stile lever lock
  • Replaces Adams-Rite style lock systems
  • Levers on exterior & interior
  • Auto-locking with passage function.
  • Ideal for aluminum storefront doors and gates
  • Highly weather resistant
  • Lifetime mechanical warranty
